earlier_attempts.reason: provider_changed guard: raw readback did not equal the assumed explicit provider; the isolated endpoint guard was reached and matched first. GUI was not started.
A previously absent default profile directory appeared; metadata classification required before treating this as isolated.
Core defaults absent and private Electron state observed; vendor Application Support namespace gained one unclassified entry. Narrow fresh-CI scope must explicitly own and remove that new namespace.

verified: The exact signed vendor DMG, app version and Apple Silicon launcher/backend were preserved.
Strict deep package signature verification passed before launch; four selected package asset hashes matched after normal exit.
A direct no-turn bundled app-server initialized, read the explicit built-in provider and local endpoint from the fresh CODEX_HOME, reported no account and exited normally.
The actual Electron Desktop opened a visible window and spawned one observed bundled backend; 13 owned children were observed exited after Cmd-Q.
The private Electron profile contained Local State and Default; the normal .codex and normal Codex/ChatGPT profiles remained absent.
A previously absent vendor Application Support namespace was explicitly bounded by owner, mode, canonical path and inode, then removed after normal exit. Its purpose remains unknown.
The short private QA state root and vendor namespace were removed without copying real account or user config data.
Config/environment and bounded profile diagnosis helpers passed three focused privacy/shape tests; native preparation reported 31 Python tests passed and one skipped.
Native input fingerprints and selected package hashes matched before/after the accepted narrow run.
remaining: Desktop to Headroom to controlled local provider request/response and actual GUI config adoption
authorized live macOS provider/account and saved endpoint adoption acceptance
main H048 final quality gate and release/compatibility acceptance
limits: This preflight requests no model turn. It does not prove Desktop model traffic, savings, provider authentication or model/subagent compatibility.
Config/read was a separate direct bundled backend session; observing a GUI backend child is not evidence that the GUI adopted the endpoint.
No recognized sign-in or API-key button was captured in the bounded 27-control snapshot; account UI capability remains unknown.

The original strict all-state isolation guard failed. The accepted narrower fresh-CI scope permits and removes owned com.openai.codex Application Support state; its purpose and full application state isolation remain unestablished.
The result is specific to macOS 15.8.2 ARM64, Desktop 26.1106.51428 and bundled CLI 0.167.0-alpha.4.1. It does not establish other versions/architectures.
This is an official vendor app preflight, not a Headroom production release/signing acceptance. No online revocation or long-duration stability claim.
